turns.text: And I read something recently that was like, imagine someone's pouring like itching powder all over you all day.
turns.zh: 我最近读到个说法，大概是，想象有人一整天往你身上倒痒痒粉。

turns.text: And they're pouring it on you and they say, "You know what?
turns.zh: 他们一边往你身上倒，一边说：「你知道吗？

turns.text: You should really learn how to meditate so you don't get bothered by all the itching." And it's like, wait a minute.
turns.zh: 你真该学学怎么冥想，这样就不会被痒得难受了。」然后你就想，等等，什么？
